for i in $(seq 1 8); do
  f=task_directory/file$i
  touch "$f"
  d1=$((RANDOM%8)); d2=$((RANDOM%8)); d3=$((RANDOM%8))
  mode="${d1}${d2}${d3}"
  chmod "$mode" "$f"
done
sum_dec=0; sum_oct_dec=0
for f in task_directory/*; do
  perm=$(stat -c '%a' "$f")
  echo "$f $perm"
  sum_dec=$((sum_dec+perm))
  sum_oct_dec=$((sum_oct_dec + 8#$perm))
done
sum_octal=$(printf "%o" "$sum_oct_dec")
echo "SUM_DECIMAL=$sum_dec"
echo "SUM_OCTAL_DECIMAL=$sum_oct_dec"
echo "SUM_OCTAL=$sum_octal""}
